recipes.name: Chicken and pepper stir-fry with garlic and soy
recipes.method_note: Have everything cut before the wok goes on. It moves fast.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} thinly.
Mix {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}} with 3 tbsp water.
Get {{ing:egg-noodles-dry}} ready: soak or heat as the packet says.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a wok on the highest heat until it shimmers.
Stir-fry {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} 5 minutes, until browned. Lift out.
Stir-fry {{ing:pepper-bell}} and {{ing:onion-medium}} 3 minutes, until bright but crisp.
Return the chicken. Add the sauce and {{ing:egg-noodles-dry}}. Toss 1 minute until glossy.
